facts.text: Nogud's trade in smashing and the scrags' pride in him are Living Server writing.

story:
The scrags of Snowdonia are a stony, ugly folk of the high slopes, kin to the rock sheeries, who live by picking over what comes down the mountain in the thaw. They are not clever. They are proud of one of their own above all others, and the reason is the reason for his name.

Nogud smashes things. He smashed his way out of a rockfall that buried his camp in his first winter, smashed the rocks that fell on it, smashed the scrag who had told the camp the slope was safe. He has smashed carts, gates, a mill-wheel the Caer Hurbury millers rolled up to sell to the fortress, two of the fortress's lieutenants' horses and very nearly a lieutenant, and he does not ask first, and he does not always notice whether he has finished. The scrags sing about him in the evenings. The song is short, because Nogud does not like long songs.

He keeps the western slopes on his own. The scrags of the camp south of Castle Myrddin say he would have the glacial hammer the Church is looking for, if it had ever come near him, because anything that smashes belongs to Nogud. It never came near him. The Church keeps asking.
legend: Nogud the Smasher, level 40 scrag, alone on the western slopes of Snowdonia. Aggro level 90, so he usually jumps you on sight. Plain melee, no spells, no friends: a group in the high thirties or a strong duo kills him. He is not the one with the glacial hammer for Crushed Faith, whatever the scrags say. Respawn ten minutes.
